name: email-leading-dot-excluded-apex-valid
description: An rfc822Name excluded subtree with a leading dot excludes mailboxes in subdomains, not mailboxes at the apex host. The excluded subtree .example.com does not match alice@example.com, so the chain is valid.
notes: This is the excludedSubtrees mirror of email-leading-dot-apex-invalid. It catches validators that forget the apex/subdomain distinction when the leading-dot constraint appears on the excluded side.
